9074.t: From ἀπο- (ăpo-, “away, off”) + κεφαλή (kephalḗ, “head”) + -ίζω (-ĭ́zō, denominative verb suffix).

9011.t: From ἀν- (an-, “without”) + ὄνυμα (ónuma, Aeolic dialectal form of ὄνομα (ónoma, “name”)) + -ος (-os, adjective-forming suffix).

9099.t: From ἀπο- (apo-, “out, away from”) + πτύω (ptū́ō, “spit out”).

9004.t: Koine adjective, from an ancient neuter ἀντίθετον (antítheton, “rhetorical antithesis”) . Deverbal from ἀντιτίθημι (ăntĭtĭ́thēmĭ, “set against”) (ἀντι- (anti-) + stem θε- as in τίθημι (títhēmi) - θετός (thetós)) + -τος (-tos).

9085.t: From ἀπο- (ăpo-, “back”) + λόγος (lógos, “speech”) + -ία (-ĭ́ā, abstract noun–forming suffix).

9088.t: From ἀπό- (ăpó-, “from”) + λέγω (légō, “to choose; to say”).

9020.t: From ἀν- (an-, “not”) + ἀλγέω (algéō, “feel bodily pain, suffer”) + -τος (-tos, adjectival suffix).

9010.t: From Proto-Indo-European *senh₂- (“to seek, accomplish, work on, succeed”). Cognate with Sanskrit सन् (san, “to gain, acquire, be successful”), as well as perhaps Hittite 𒊭𒀭𒄴𒍣 (ša-an-aḫ-zi, “to seek”).
